name: ServiceChannel
positioning: Facilities management for multi-site occupiers — one contractor marketplace, one invoice standard, across hundreds of locations.
description: ServiceChannel manages facilities maintenance for multi-location businesses: work order dispatch, a contractor network with compliance tracking, invoice validation against agreed rates, asset and warranty tracking, and spend analytics across sites.
real_estate_use: A retailer with four hundred stores has four hundred sets of local contractors and no consistent way to know whether a bill is fair. ServiceChannel standardises the workflow: a store manager raises an issue, dispatch goes to a compliant contractor at contracted rates, and invoices that exceed the agreed rate are flagged before payment. The saving is in the invoice validation as much as in the dispatch.
features: Work order intake, dispatch and tracking across sites
Contractor network with insurance and compliance verification
Asset and warranty tracking by location
Spend analytics by site, trade and provider

use_cases.job: Standardise maintenance dispatch and invoice control across hundreds of sites
See maintenance spend by trade and location instead of by supplier invoice
